title: date unknown - After being grounded because of a shortage of equipment, the airline Transportes Aéreos Bandeirantes is sold to Lóide Aéreo Nacional.
text: Transportes Aéreos Bandeirantes was a Brazilian airline founded in 1945. In 1950 it was incorporated by Lóide Aéreo Nacional.

title: The 1950 World Cup begins in Brazil.
text: The 1950 FIFA World Cup was the fourth edition of the FIFA World Cup, the quadrennial international football championship for senior men's national teams. It was held in Brazil from 24 June to 16 July 1950.

title: A Constellation plane crashes into Morro do Chapéu, near Porto Alegre airport, killing 50 people.
text: The Lockheed Constellation is a propeller-driven, four-engined airliner built by Lockheed Corporation starting in 1943. The Constellation series was the first civil airliner family to enter widespread use equipped with a pressurized cabin, enabling it to fly well above most bad weather, thus improving the general safety and ease of commercial passenger air travel.

title: The first television channel in Brazil, TV Tupi opens in São Paulo, by businessman Assis Chateaubriand.
text: Francisco de Assis Chateaubriand Bandeira de Melo, also nicknamed Chatô (October 4, 1892 – April 4, 1968), was a Brazilian lawyer, journalist, politician and diplomat. text: Ulrich Becher was a German author and playwright.

title: Caiçara, co-directed by Adolfo Celi, Tom Payne, and John Waterhouse, starring Celi and José Mauro de Vasconcelos.
text: Adolfo Celi was an Italian film actor and director. Born in Curcuraci, Messina, Sicily, Celi appeared in nearly 100 films.

title: Caraça, Porta do Céu, directed by Theodor Luts, starring José Álvaro Morais.
text: Theodor Luts was an Estonian film director and cinematographer, brother of classic writer Oskar Luts. Theodor Luts was the first major figure of Estonian cinematography His Noored kotkad (Young Eagles) (1927) is generally regarded as the cornerstone of Estonian cinema.

title: Quando a Noite Acaba, starring Tônia Carrero.
text: Maria Antonieta Portocarrero Thedim, known professionally as Tônia Carrero, was a Brazilian actress.
